result.rationale: One missing platform is proven: Xchange Telecom LLC. Skywire is its division/brand, not a second investment. NOVA closed a 100% founder equity transfer on 2022-11-28 through NOVA-Xchange Investco, L.P.; 2026 regulatory and current NOVA evidence still show NOVA control.

identityResolution.history: Founded/authorized in 2002; renamed from Xchange Telecom Corp. in 2015. Skywire division formed in 2012; brands combined commercially in 2023.
identityResolution.boundary: Count once as Xchange Telecom LLC; current terms define Skywire as its business division. Do not retain the slash label or create Skywire separately.

ownershipResolution.control: Founders transferred all equity; no founder/management rollover disclosed. NOVA controls Investco's GP chain.
ownershipResolution.fundAndCoinvestors: Investco economics: 71% Fund I, 27% NOVA blocker, 2% NOVA GP structure. No direct co-investor. AAA Sub Fund 3-Y's 10.7% look-through interest was passive; Apollo-related entities and Fund I LPs had no Xchange voting/control.

operatingResolution.profile: Internet, Ethernet, voice, mobile, SD-WAN, managed Wi-Fi and cloud connectivity.
operatingResolution.networkAndMarkets: Hybrid fixed-wireless/fiber/copper access and private rooftop wireless network in NYC, upstate NY and NJ; nationwide reach is partner-enabled.
operatingResolution.scale: 2022: >2,000 lit buildings, 50 hubs/relays, >350,000 near-net buildings. Current FAQ: >3,000 enterprise/SMB and >28,000 residential customers.
operatingResolution.qualification: Facilities-based North American digital infrastructure serving dense and underserved markets.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: NOVA's 2021-09-20 $16.15m loan was debt. After default, SPA signed 2022-11-11 and founders transferred 100% in lieu of foreclosure at the 2022-11-28 close; announced 2022-11-29.
acquisitionExitCheck.regulatoryState: NY PSC issued prospective conditional approval on 2026-07-21; public acceptance/affidavit filings were not located by 2026-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No later add-on, recapitalization, equity investor, sale, exit or signed pending ownership deal found; NOVA still lists the company current and identifies Skywire directors.

milestones.event: Xchange founded/authorized; LLC name adopted in 2015.
